entries.prompt: Create a new standalone square 1:1 Elven parchment SCROLL UI BACKGROUND asset, on genuine transparent alpha outside its silhouette. Theme: the Two Trees of Valinor and the High Elves. Realistic premium fantasy game interface art, elegant refined craftsmanship, physically plausible parchment and metal, crisp alpha cutout, no smoke, no glowing haze outside silhouette, no cast shadow background, no border rectangle behind object, no UI text or icons. This is a usable scroll panel background, not a scene and not a mockup.

Create a single small circular emblem icon for a premium Two Trees of Valinor / High Elven dashboard, genuine transparent alpha background.
